Database.// MigrationsPath: Directory of reviewed *.sql migrations (PostgreSQL only). Empty/absent = disabled — the default. DEV keeps this empty: InitTables builds the schema. PRODUCTION sets it to the deployed migrations dir so 001-core-baseline.sql bootstraps the core schema on an empty DB (no InitTables). See db/migrations/README.md.

Testing.// PostgresConnection: Opt-in PG integration suite (PostgresIntegrationTests). Set in appsettings.Development.json to a DISPOSABLE database whose name contains 'test'. Empty = tests skip. Env var STRUO_TEST_PG_CONNECTION overrides.

RateLimiting.// Login: SEC-7 app-layer login rate limiter (POST /api/auth/login only). Enabled=true is secure-by-default for direct/single-instance deployments. Set Enabled=false in multi-pod deployments (e.g. Kubernetes) where per-IP rate limiting is enforced at the ingress/edge/WAF instead — this in-memory limiter is per-pod and cannot enforce a true global limit across replicas. Override via env e.g. RateLimiting__Login__Enabled=false (read at startup; changing it requires a restart).
